summary: Mobile responsiveness verification (layout-only change). Verified ZERO page-level horizontal scroll (documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth) at 390x844 on all 16 public routes (/, /about, /model-portfolios, /aif, /advisory, /faq, /login, /signup, /calculators, /explore/legacy, /mutual-funds, /stocks, /fixed-deposits, /collections, /learn, /managers) and at 320x568 spot-checks (/, /model-portfolios, /admin). Admin console at /admin on 390px: sidebar has correctly collapsed to a horizontal scrollable top tab bar; iterated through all 11 tabs (Home content, About Us, Managers, Collections, Mutual funds, FAQ, Leads, Listings, Partner applications, Database, Site settings) — every tab keeps sw=390/cw=390 (no page-level hscroll). Regression at desktop: admin login (admin@basketly.in/Admin@123) still works, About Us tab still saves ('About page saved' toast confirmed). OrderTicket and InvestFlow modals could NOT be opened via UI: (a) OrderTicket is only reachable when kiteConnected=true (real Kite OAuth) — the Broker Connect page only exposes Zerodha OAuth + Groww 'coming soon'; there is no demo-broker button in the current UI, and the mobile navbar menu does not contain a 'Trade' entry (Trade lives inside the lg: desktop nav only, gated on kiteConnected). (b) InvestFlow needs an approved model portfolio detail page but /model-portfolios shows '0 model portfolios' (no seeded/approved portfolios in this env). Static verification of the responsive classes: OrderTicket.jsx and InvestFlow.jsx both contain the expected grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 / flex-col sm:flex-row patterns and DialogContent uses sm:max-w-lg with overflow-hidden — so the layout fix is present in code, only end-to-end triggering was blocked by data/OAuth.
action_items: MINOR / OPTIONAL: If Trade should be reachable on mobile (the review request refers to a 'Trade entry in the navbar mobile menu'), add a Trade button to the mobile menu block in /app/frontend/src/components/Navbar.jsx (currently the Trade button is only rendered inside the hidden lg:flex block, so mobile users cannot open OrderTicket even when kiteConnected=true).

OPTIONAL: To make OrderTicket/InvestFlow modals testable in the preview env, expose a 'Use demo broker' button on /brokers/connect and/or seed at least one approved model portfolio so the detail page + Invest flow is reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar mobile menu (Navbar.jsx lines 93-114) does NOT include a Trade button; only Dashboard / Connect broker / Log out. The Trade button (line 56-60) is inside the desktop-only 'hidden lg:flex' block. This is likely an oversight of the mobile responsiveness pass.

OrderTicket.jsx and InvestFlow.jsx correctly use grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 and flex-col sm:flex-row for mobile stacking; DialogContent uses sm:max-w-lg/md which naturally caps width on larger screens and stretches to viewport on mobile — layout is sound in static review.
AdminPage horizontal tab bar behaviour verified live: all 11 tabs remain within a scrollable container without pushing document width, at both 390 and 320.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (16/16 public routes + 11/11 admin tabs + About-save regression). 2/2 modal flows blocked by env (no demo broker path, 0 approved model portfolios) — matches E1's agent-to-agent note.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile no-hscroll is green across all public routes, /dashboard, /admin (all 11 tabs), at 390 and 320. OrderTicket and InvestFlow modals were NOT opened end-to-end because (a) Kite OAuth is required to reveal the Trade button and there is no demo broker option in /brokers/connect; and (b) the model-portfolios listing shows '0 model portfolios' so no detail page can be visited. Responsive classes are verified present in OrderTicket.jsx / InvestFlow.jsx source. The main agent may wish to add a Trade entry to the mobile navbar menu (currently desktop-only).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found in the layout changes under test. The two modals that could not be triggered are blocked by environment data (no demo-broker onboarding + 0 seeded model portfolios), not by the layout code.
